name: Cryogenic SF6/O2 ICP-RIE of vertical Si nanowire arrays at -95 C and 1.0 Pa
plain_name: Carve tall silicon nanowires with a plasma while the wafer is chilled to -95 C
description: Lithographically masked n-type Si(100) is etched in a SENTECH SI 500C cryogenic ICP-RIE with the default recipe -95 C, 1.0 Pa, SF6 118 sccm / O2 13 sccm, ICP 500 W, RF 6 W, 5 min, using thermally conductive oil between sample and holder; the SiOxFy passivation formed at low temperature yields 15-21 um nanowires with near-vertical sidewalls.
keywords: Carve tall silicon nanowires with a plasma while the wafer is chilled to -95 C

sources.citation: Versatilely tuned vertical silicon nanowire arrays by cryogenic reactive ion etching as a lithium-ion battery anode (Refino et al., Scientific Reports 11, 2021, doi:10.1038/s41598-021-99173-4)

reported_equipment: cryogenic SI 500C plasma etcher from SENTECH Instruments GmbH

requirements.rationale: The default recipe runs the substrate holder at -95 C = 178.15 K.
The plasma etch runs in an evacuated chamber at 1.0 Pa.
The chamber must be able to reach and hold the 1.0 Pa process pressure.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
